
# **Tipping Study - pt.4 Prep data for modeling**

---

Setup
---

#### Workspace

```{r}
rm(list = ls())

if (!requireNamespace("here")) install.packages("here")
source(here::here("r", "utilities", "workspace.r"))

library(data.table)
library(dplyr)

load(here::here("data", "proc", "03_out.rdata"))
```

Drop superfluous columns created along the way.

```{r}
local({
  keep_these <- c(
    "participant", "trajectory",
    "hand_used", "side_used",
    "target_loc", "distractor_loc", "object_tipped",
    "hand_x", "hand_y", "hand_z"
  )
  dt <<- dt[, .SD, .SDcols = (keep_these)]
})
```

Need to put reaches on equal footing by restricting to correct responses... first though, what are accuracies like?

```{r}
dt[
  ,
  unique(object_tipped),
  .(participant, trajectory)
][
  ,
  mean(V1 == "target"), participant
]
```

Everyone is well into the 90's, no need for exclusions (beyond the errant reaches themselves)

```{r}
dt <- droplevels(dt[object_tipped == "target"])
```

For now, only interested in reaches to central targets

```{r}
dt <- droplevels(dt[target_loc == "centre"])
```
Recoding
---

#### Predictors

Objects' literal positions were procedurally relevant, but tangential to inference.

Instead, dummy factors will be coded representing:

- Distractor side (oppo, facing)
  - Whether or not the effector side faces the distractor
- Side used (back, front)
- Hand used (left, right)

```{r}
dt[
  ,
  distractor_side := factor(
    fcase(
      distractor_loc == hand_used & side_used == "front", "opposite",
      distractor_loc == hand_used & side_used == "back", "facing",
      distractor_loc != hand_used & side_used == "front", "facing",
      distractor_loc != hand_used & side_used == "back", "opposite"
    ),
    levels = c("opposite", "facing"),
    labels = c("Opposite", "Facing")
  )
]

dt[
  ,
  hand_used := factor(
    hand_used,
    levels = c("right", "left"),
    labels = c("Righthand", "Lefthand")
  )
]

dt[
  ,
  side_used := factor(
    side_used,
    levels = c("back", "front"),
    labels = c("Back", "Palm"),
  )
]
```

Normalization
---

#### Clip trajectories

Only interested in early behaviour.

```{r}
dt <- dt[hand_z <= 10]
```

#### Spatially normalize trajectories

Resample data points from splined fits

```{r}
dt <- dt[
  ,
  .(
    hand_x = spline(seq_along(hand_x), hand_x, 1000)$y,
    hand_z = spline(seq_along(hand_z), hand_x, 1000)$y
  ),
  by = .(trajectory, participant, distractor_side, hand_used, side_used)
] |>
  _[,
    .(
      hand_x = hand_x[seq(1, 1000, length.out = 100)],
      hand_z = hand_z[seq(1, 1000, length.out = 100)],
      index = 1:100
    ),
    by = .(trajectory, participant, distractor_side, hand_used, side_used)
  ]
```

Overall avg's

```{r}
dt |>
  summarize(
    mean_x = mean(hand_x),
    mean_z = mean(hand_z),
    index = unique(index),
    .by = c(hand_used, distractor_side, side_used, index, participant)
  ) |>
  summarize(
    mean_x = mean(mean_x),
    mean_z = mean(mean_z),
    index = unique(index),
    .by = c(hand_used, distractor_side, side_used, index)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = mean_x,
    y = index,
    color = side_used,
    linetype = distractor_side
  )) +
  geom_path() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-5, 1)) +
  facet_grid(~hand_used) +
  labs(
    title = "First 10cm of reach; all conditions",
    y = "Portion of reach",
    x = "X-pos (mm)"
  )
```

```{r}
require(patchwork)

left_gg <- dt |>
  summarize(
    hand_x = mean(hand_x),
    .by = c(hand_used, distractor_side, side_used, index, participant)
  ) |>
  filter(hand_used == "Lefthand") |>
  summarize(
    hand_x = mean(hand_x),
    .by = c(side_used, distractor_side, index)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = hand_x,
    y = index,
    color = distractor_side
  )) +
  geom_path() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-3, 3)) +
  facet_grid(~side_used) +
  labs(
    subtitle = "Lefthand",
    y = "Portion of reach",
    x = "X-pos (mm; pos = dir of hand)"
  )

right_gg <- dt |>
  summarize(
    hand_x = mean(hand_x),
    .by = c(hand_used, distractor_side, side_used, index, participant)
  ) |>
  filter(hand_used == "Righthand") |>
  summarize(
    hand_x = mean(hand_x),
    .by = c(side_used, distractor_side, index)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = hand_x,
    y = index,
    color = distractor_side
  )) +
  geom_path() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-3, 3)) +
  facet_grid(~side_used) +
  labs(
    subtitle = "Righthand",
    y = "Portion of reach",
    x = "X-pos (mm; pos = dir of hand)"
  )

(right_gg | left_gg) + plot_layout(guides = "collect", axes = "collect")
```


Effect of distractor side (opposite - facing)

```{r}
dt |>
  summarize(
    hand_x = mean(hand_x),
    .by = c(hand_used, distractor_side, side_used, index, participant)
  ) |>
  filter(!participant %in% c("35", "37")) |>
  summarize(
    d_eff = hand_x[distractor_side == "Opposite"] - hand_x[distractor_side == "facing"],
    .by = c(hand_used, side_used, index, participant)
  ) |>
  summarize(
    mean_eff = mean(d_eff),
    .by = c(hand_used, side_used, index)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = mean_eff,
    y = index,
    color = side_used
  )) +
  geom_path() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-5, 1)) +
  facet_grid(~hand_used) +
  labs(
    title = "Distractor eff (oppo - facing side)",
    y = "Portion of reach",
    x = "X-pos (mm)"
  )
```

Effect of side-of-hand (back - front)

```{r}
dt |>
  summarize(
    hand_x = mean(hand_x),
    .by = c(hand_used, distractor_side, side_used, index, participant)
  ) |>
  filter(!participant %in% c("35", "37")) |>
  summarize(
    h_eff = hand_x[side_used == "Back"] - hand_x[side_used == "Front"],
    .by = c(hand_used, distractor_side, index, participant)
  ) |>
  summarize(
    mean_eff = mean(h_eff),
    .by = c(hand_used, distractor_side, index)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = mean_eff,
    y = index,
    color = distractor_side
  )) +
  geom_path() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-5, 1)) +
  facet_grid(~hand_used) +
  labs(
    title = "Effector eff (back - front side)",
    y = "Portion of reach",
    x = "X-pos (mm)"
  )
```
